batting.dismissal: c Shakib Al Hasan b R Vinay Kumar

batting.name: S Anirudha
batting.dismissal: st RV Uthappa b Shakib Al Hasan

batting.name: JO Holder

batting.name: RV Uthappa
batting.dismissal: c JO Holder b KV Sharma

batting.name: MK Pandey
batting.dismissal: c DW Steyn b KV Sharma

batting.name: Shakib Al Hasan
batting.dismissal: c JO Holder b KV Sharma

balls.text: a low full toss is drilled towards long-on for a single to end the over, Sunrisers end on 160
and even more drama, a shortish ball from Vinay, Karn wants to hammer it through point, gets a top edge, Uthappa leaps and gets a glove on it but the ball zips through for four
and now Sammy is dismissed, goes for the big hit, doesn't middle this length ball and holes out to Shakib at sweeper cover, what an action-packed innings this is!

shortish ball from round the wicket, Holder goes for the big hit, he doesn't connect, Sammy had zipped through for the bye, wasn't he writhing in pain just a few minutes ago? in any case, he has motored through, Holder hasn't responded early enough, Uthappa lobs the ball to the bowler, Holder is run-out and he is furious, absolutely furious
a full toss, thick inside-edge onto the pad, Sammy is frustrated at missing out on that one
too far outside off, called a wide
whoah! how on earth did that go for six, it is full and very wide, Sammy plonks his front foot forward and reaches out for it, connects and connects well, the ball sails over backward point for six
a length ball is absolutely hammered by Holder, a diving fielder at long-off can't cut that off as it has too much pace on it

length ball, Sammy was going for the massive swing that he usually does, inside-edge that onto his knee cap on his back leg, I think, Sammy is in serious pain here, he is so much pain that he can barely take the single, hobbling through, nearly gives up midway through
another full toss, towards long-on for a single
full toss this time, clubbed to the square leg boundary for four
swings hard and connects, hammers that over long-on for a massive six
off the thigh pad towards the leg side
blocks this fulle delivery
is there another run-out here, pushed towards cover, straight to Shakib, who fires the ball to the keeper, Holder has to dive back to beat the throw
another huge lbw appeal, another one where KKR thought they had a wicket, was that sliding down, I don't think it was, the umpire thought it was, otherwise that was another plumb one
flatbatted off the back foot towards long-off
eased towards long-on for a single
pushed towards the off to end another tidy over

huge appeal for lbw, looked dead plumb, hit in front of middle on the back thigh, no trouble with the height, the umpire has to have thought there was an edge there, else Holder was a goner, Shakib looks at the skies and screams in frustration
pushed  towards the off side
ripper from Shakib! drifts in and is a touch short, much too short for Anirudhha who was skipping down the track, the ball then turns away and Aniruddha can't get bat on it, stumped by a long way
brutal hit from Sammy towards cow corner, just fetches him a single as the placement isn't great
length ball, tossed up, worked towards midwicket for a single
length ball on the pads, pushed towards mid-on, Narine has to chase, Aniruddha wants two, Narine is quick to the ball though and they settle for one
spinning in towards the pad, beats the bat but off the pads for a leg bye
helped towards backward square leg for a single
defended to the off side this time, again Narine keeping it tight
eased past point for a single
carefully defended by Sammy

another run-out! Venugopal Rao's kamikaze innings is over, the ball is swept away towards deep midwicket, where Vinay Kumar seems to have over run the ball, adjusts well to stop the ball from reaching the rope, Pandey is there to help out, he fires in a superb throw, Venugopal is nowhere near making his ground, he had ambled the first, and then stumbled after stepping on Shakib's leg
a single only, towards sweeper cover
serious power from Sammy, with the ball not really coming on he still manages to hammer the ball to wide long-on for four
no doubt about this one, right off the middle of the bat, around length, way over long-on for six

dropped, right through the hands of Yusuf Pathan at long-on, who has dropped catches previously when he goes with the reverse-cup technique, once again he puts it down, and is struck on the cheek before the ball goes away for six, it was a poor ball to start, Sammy thought he was out, results in a six
swept towards deep backward square leg for a single
inside-edge onto the body for a single
this is comical cricket, Venugopal swings yet again, one more outside edge, flies away to the third-man boundary
short and quick outside off, Venugopal swings his bat at it and misses

dropped, Venugopal Rao has decided to swing at everything, he wants to smash that over the leg side, a top edge sends it flying towards third man where Sunil Narine has to leap to get that one, just gets a finger on it when he should have latched on, one-bounce four
again Venugopal wants to thrash the ball away, this time he connects, over backward point for four, that was short and wide from Morkel
Morkel is in for his final over, 140.5kph, shortish and outside off, Venugopal wants to thrash that one, doesn't connect
hit to extra cover to end a superb over for KKR
solidly defended off the front foot
spinning away outside off, flighted delivery goes past the outside edge
Sammy is in much earlier than he would have wanted, defended towards extra cover

outstanding bit of fielding there from Manish Pandey, results in the big wicket of Dhawan, the ball was hammered by Dhawan towards extra cover, Pandey dived to his right to stop that one, holds on to it on the second chance, and fires in an accurate throw to the keeper even before he gets up, Dhawan is caught short
full ball on off stump, driven towards extra cover
spinning away, defended towards cover
towards sweeper cover for a single
that is a beauty from Narine, a legbreak at 100kph, much too good for Venugopal Rao, who grops at it but is beaten, off the thigh pad
turns away way outside off, chopped towards sweeper cover for one more
spins away outside off, played off the back foot towards sweeper cover
length ball is worked towards midwicket for a single, Venugopal turns over the strike to Dhawan
this one is defended back towards the bowler
length ball sliding on, defended towards square leg
pushed towards mid-off for a single
goes for the sweep once more, this time there is no contact, ball strikes the shoulder after Venugopal has gone through with the shot
sweeps from way outside off stump, a top edge and the ball runs away towards deep backward square leg where Vinay Kumar pulls off a sliding stop
does he have a wicket first up, he flights this one, Venugopal can't get bat on ball, Uthappa takes off the bails, is Venugopal's back leg down in time, it's tight, think he is just in
blocked down the track to end the over, short of length ball on middle stump
stop the press, a single! full ball on the pads is whipped towards deep square leg
three dot balls and a boundary, that could be the title if they make a movie of this innings, short and wide from Vinay, thumped beyond backward point for four
there's the Vinay outswinger, Venugopal is drawn towards it but is beaten by the movement
Venugopal looks to hammer that towards midwicket, can't get bat on ball and is struck on the thigh pad, why is he not looking for a single, give the strike to Dhawan
short of length ball coming in towards off, defended solidly
defended towards point for a single, a rare economical over from Umesh
sprays that down the leg side
slower one, well I thought it was a slower one, speed gun says 137kph, on middle stump, defended down the pitch
goes for the Hollywood drive, nowhere near the pitch of the ball, bat gets nowhere near the ball as it zips through to the keeper
guided towards deep backward point this time
a single to get off the mark
moving away outside off, beaten

Ojha sends this one high up in the air as well, this wasn't off the middle though as he looked to pick the ball off the pads, top edge and the ball is swirling around, RTD gets under it, has plenty of time to visualise how he might make a mess of it, and then pouches it, Ojha punches his helmet as he walks off
Ojha doesn't believe in singles and twos, after three dot balls he makes up with a huge six over midwicket, that ball went a long way up, but clears the rope by a handful of yards
short of length ball is pushed back towards RTD, who fields and shapes up to fire the ball back at the stumps, the Eden crowd loves it
a yorker on middle stump, swings a bit as well, pushed towards mid-on
length ball on off stump, defended towards mid-on
there's a rare single, chopped towards deep point by Dhawan
this time Ojha chases after the ball outside off, 136.8kph, can't get bat on ball there
short of length and moving away outside off, 139kph from Umesh, left alone by Ojha
gets forward and square drives this for four more, more solid contact this time, gets it past a diving backward point
length ball sliding down the leg side, helped along for four more to fine leg, poor ball that, gifting runs
towards backward square leg for a leg bye
not entirely in control there, a healthy outside edge sends the ball down to the third-man boundary
defends the final ball of the over
this one zips away from Ojha, outside edge and leaves Ojha flustered, this is more like the Narine IPL fans have come to expect
bounce for Narine as he drops it a touch short, outside off left alone
another drive for four, though this time it was streaky, a thick outside edge as the ball flies past backward point for four though Ojha was looking to send it past cover
defended towards backward point this time
Narine is on, and he's welcomed by an inside-out drive for four through extra cover, best bowler in the IPL? 'I dont' care,' Ojha says
outside off, Dhawan chases it and misses, top over that from Morkel
more bad luck for Morkel as he beats Dhawan once more, but the ball flies off the pads past the keeper for four leg byes

Dhawan is opened up by that one, 146.1 kph, again the Morkel length, called a Morkel motorway by Damien Fleming, Dhawan looks to defend but he's playing down the wrong line as the ball has curled away
short of length on the body, Dhawan is cramped as he pulls that to square leg
a ripper from Morkel, 142.8kph, short of length ball moves away just a touch away, Dhawan is beaten as he looks to defend
driven towards mid-off by Dhawan as Morkel begins his third over
once more, shortish and wide outside off, no boundary this time though as third man is wide, Dhawan guides it for a single
once more, behind backward point for four, dropping a bit too short here Vinay, easy for Dhawan to deal with those
shot, width on offer for Dhawan, he capitalises, thrashes it behind backward point
short of length jagging away, Dhawan gets forward and weakly pokes at it, misses
defended towards cover point
Dhawan steps down the track and flays that through cover, shortish and wide outside off, easy put away for Dhawan
short and outside off, Ojha looks to chop that past point but misses
it all goes wrong for Morkel, after an accurate over he sprays this miles (cricketing metric) down the leg side, no chance for Uthappa
short of length and on off stump, dropped in front of point for a quick single
144.6kph, typical Morkel length, Dhawan confidently gets on the front foot and looks to drive on the up, beaten
the man at cover point was flying to his right hoping to get a hand on that, but Dhawan gets it wide of Manish Pandey to get a boundary to backward point
on off stump, 145.8kph, pushed off the front foot towards cover
Morkel gets that to rise sharply and zip away past the outside edge, Dhawan doesn't move his feet much as he wafts at it
length ball on off stump, defended towards cover off the front foot
looking to start the movement from middle and leg, it doesn't curve back and ends up on the pads, four leg byes to fine leg
beauty from Vinay Kumar, back of length ball curls away from Ojha, who shows little footwork as he pecks at it, beaten
Dhawan goes for a big shot and gets a thick inside edge towards fine leg
huge appeal for caught behind, short of length curving in, past the inside edge and think that was off the thigh pad through to the keeper, Vinay getting the ball to hag around
short of length and outside off, slapped towards backward point by Dhawan
length ball on the pads, clipped elegantly off the pads to the midwicket boundary for four
solidly defended off the front foot to the off side
quick shortish ball outside off, another leave
short of length and outside off, left alone

big blow here, Morne Morkel has knocked over the dangerous Warner, back of a length ball hits the top of off, Warner leaves a huge gap between bat and pad as he looks to drive, off stump finds itself yards behind its usual position
wide down the leg side
Morne Morkel steams in, quick and down the leg side, helped off the thigh pad, it races down to fine leg where a sliding Narine lets it through hsi legs to the rope
KKR get their seventh win in a row, their longest streak, and they go through as No. 2, the result is confirmed by a wide down the leg side, Sunrisers are knocked out
scores are level, as there's yet another six, Suryakumar skips down the track and hammers that over long-on
short of length ball outside off, guided towards backward point
eased to long-off for a single, been a while since I got to type something as simple as that

and it's over, a special innings from Yusuf that has all but earned KKR a place in the top two, he was going for another sixbut can only get it as far as Dhawan at deep midwicket, he knows the job is virtually done, clearly enjoyed this innings, punches gloves with suryakumar before walking off, raises his bat and an adoring crowd replies with raucous cheers
six more! I need to keep that on copy-paste, Karn drops it short and Yusuf sends it over to the delirious Eden Gardens crowd for six more
looks to whip this to the leg side, towards short fine leg for the first dot ball off his innings
another sweep, this time a more powerful one towards deep square leg
it's not all about power, Suryakumar shows the finesses with a lap-sweep for four
full ball on the pads, clipped towards deep square leg for two more, 26 off the over, that's the most expensive one Steyn has bowled in IPL
fifth ball of the over, fifth ball that goes to the boundary, thick outside edge past the keeper for four more, Eden Gardens is loving it
four more! Yusuf pulls this short ball to the square-leg boundary, Steyn being taken apart here, CSK worried now
length ball from Steyn and he has been bludgeoned over long-off for six more, world's best bowler? Yusuf doesn't care
electric from Yusuf, just 15 balls for his 50, incredible innings from him, he has just dispatched steyn over midwicket for a mammoth six
shortish and wide, Yusuf power to the fore, hits low on the bat as he looks to slug it to the leg side, the ball whizzes past the bowler and goes away for four
Shakib looks to join the fun, he skips down the track and throws his bat it, slices the ball, it goes high and reaches only as far as Jason Holder at long-off, no mistakes this time in the field
gets on the back foot and nonchalantly whips this one towards deep square leg
Eden Gardens going berserk as Yusuf Pathan goes berserk, a length ball is sent over long-off for six, this was not middle, it was sliced, still enough power on it to carry for six
short of length ball is slashed towards deep point, Yusuf slips a bit as he comes back for a tight second, but he survives as the throw from Warner is a bit wide giving him the extra time
big, big hit, Yusuf sends that length ball way beyond the boundary rope, many, many rows behind the rope, KKR are on the charge
looking to tuck the ball towards square leg, off the pads for a leg-bye

another misfield, this time at long-on, Holder is all arms and legs as he flops over trying to stop the ball, he seems to have done so, but just as he gets up he palms the ball over the rope, quite comical that

dropped, this was clubbed towards deep square leg, serious power on it, but you expect Dale Steyn to hand on to this sort of overhead chance, he doesn't and that's six, Rasool is incensed, Sammy isn't too pleased either
short ball outside off, thick outside edge races past short third man for four, this game has had a lot of inside and outside edges
length ball is eased towards sweeper cover for a single, over to Yusuf
short of length ball is slapped towards long-on for a single
Yusuf shows us why he became an IPL sensation, a massive hit over square leg as Rasool drops it a touch short, that one has travelled a long way
thick inside edge onto the back pad , the ball rolls away towards point
slides on outside off, slapped towards point

there have been several run-outs already today, there's one more now, a length ball is hammered back at the bowler, who puts down a difficult chance to his left, ten Doeschate sets off for the run, there isn't much of a response from Yusuf, RtD has to scramble back, but he is a long way from safety when the keeper takes the bails off
length ball just outside off, whipped in front of square leg
he's gone now, Uthappa looked to launch that against the spin, doesn't get enough on this length ball, holes out to long-on
drops it short, in this form Uthappa is not going to miss out, he slugs this over midwicket for six more, that's nine consecutive scores above 40, that is an incredible achievement in T20
full ball on middle stump is whipped to deep square leg for a single
another short one, this one is off the bottom of the bat, but it is placed wide of David Warner at deep midwicket for four more
cracking shot from Uthappa, short ball is pummelled over midwicket, he moved away from leg and made sure he made proper contact, way back in the crowd
slow full toss, more than knee-high, whipped down to fine leg
steered towards short third man for a single
shortish ball, Yusuf goes for the wild slog again, thick bottom edge and could have rolled back to the stumps

dropped, S Aniruddha has put down an absolute sitter, Yusuf thought he was gone and was walking off, it was typical Yusuf slog, flew to the man at deep midwicket, coming straight at Aniruddha, who barely gets a finger on it as he lets it through to hit his chest
length ball, a thick inside edge sends the ball behind square leg
length ball, Pandey skips down the track and slices the ball towards long-on, Steyn gobbles that up, Pandey's is out for a seven-ball two
full ball on leg stump, backs away and drives it towards mid-off
thick inside edge sends  the ball in front of square leg
full ball outside off, slower one, jammed to the off side, KKR a long way way from winning this in 15.2 overs
short ball, worked to midwicket
shortish ball, not much room for Uthappa, who still goes for the chop over cover, top edges it and drops just short of Rasool as he charges in from third man, hits him in the nose on the bounce
slower one, 114kph, Uthappa was through with his slog before the ball arrived, he loses his balances as he plays the shot as well
looking to club that out of the park after coming down the track, doesn't connect
moves across and takes that from off stump, guiding it behind square leg for a couple
length ball outside off, Pandey slaps it towards point but still can't get off the mark
losing the radar there, this one is way down the leg side
that is quick from Steyn, 146.5kph, Pandey looks to crack it through point off the back foot, he is beaten by that one outside off
look to swipe it towards midwicket, doesn't quite get it off the middle but gets a single
quick, short of length ball, Uthappa wants to whip it to midwicket but he can't get bat on it, on the pads and there is a loud appeal, but that was sliding down
Steyn bangs it in a bit short, Uthappa looks to pull after getting a bit forward, the ball bounces back towards the bowler, who grabs it and fires it towards the keeper
Uthappa sends this on one over cover, not quite off the middle but has enough on it to go for four
a touch shorter, Pandey makes room and guides the ball towards backward point
first ball is on a length at off stump, 136kph, defended to the off side by the new batsman Manish Pandey

bowled 'im! the sort of dismissal which we have seen so many times from Gambhir, once again he looks to steer the ball to third man, inside edges onto the stumps, this match is utterly packed with incident
this time it is a slower offcutter well outside off, Gambhir top edges it towards cover, where the fielder has to run back to catch it over his shoulder, he puts it down and there's time for two
four more, and another no-ball! it was a short ball that cramped up Gambhir who was looking to make room, just had enough to slam it over cover for four
bang! back of length ball is swiped over midwicket into the Eden Gardens crowd, clean hit that, it is also a no-ball, which wasn't initially signalled, but the replays showed Holder was over the line
short of length ball, defended towards point for a single
flicked off the pads towards short fine leg, Steyn can only slow the ball as he looks to stop it, allows time for two
this is driven towards mid-on, not too well timed

that rocketed to the boundary, think third man took about three or four steps before that reached the fielder there, Bhuvneshwar looks to stop that with his legs after sliding, but that ball was really travelling, Gambhir just used the pace of the bowler to slap it from off side
wild from Gambhir, a cross-batted heave to a ball that was moving away from him, gets nowhere close the ball
short of length ball on off stump, glided toward backward point where Warner is lurking, he fires in the throw making Uthappa abandon all thoughts of a single
length ball on the pads, another effortless stroke sends the ball towards deep square leg, the timing has been terrific on his shots today
a typical Gambhir single, gets on the back foot, drops the ball towards point and sets off
third boundary of the over, and this one is the best of the lot, hardly any effort as he works that pitched-up delivery towards midwicket for four more
a short ball outside off, Uthappa charges down and is forced to play a cross-batted shot, no contact
this one curls away just a touch, Uthappa plays down the wrong line and the ball whizzes past the outside edge
lovely shot from Uthappa, gets on the front foot and whips that to midwicket for four, it was a length ball on middle stump
opens the face as he steers the ball, bounces through to second slip, where it is not cleanly held, allowing a single
length ball, Gambhir skips down the track and launches that over extra cover for four
nicely forward as he pushes the fuller ball into the covers
full on off stump, Uthappa drives to mid-on with a straight bat
defended into the off side as he comes forward to meet the good length ball

had no idea where the ball was, but Uthappa was completely aware. This was on a good length but hurried onto him. Gambhir's flick fails and the ball dribbles off the pad. Single pinched as Steyn misses the target with a kick
fires a full delivery wide outside off, Gambhir looks for the drill through the covers. Instead he has to settle for a boundary through fine leg
shortish and outside off, Gambhir looked to cut over point but can't connect
presses forward and goes for a punch down the ground, Bhuvi gets this to move away from the right-hander's outside edge. Top over!
a touch shorter and this one doesn't misbehave. Gambhir steers it just behind point with soft hands
that's the trifecta! He gets it to pitch where Gambhir is not certain whether to come forward or stay back. Pokes and the movement off the deck beats him again. Those two slips better be warmed up
and again! This time it's fuller and Gambhir tentatively pushes at it. But the ball pitches and then jags away off the seam
there we go! This pitch has been responding to the new ball considerably and Bhuvi gets this one to dart past Gambhir's angled blade.
back of a length outside off, dabbed into the covers and he sets off with the shot
